title: Drayton Hall
axis: +X runs southeast along the land facade. +Z points southwest down the land approach.
source: Named main house building outline, oriented from the southwest wall and corroborated by HABS SC-377 and the preservation trust.
identityStatus: The estate map and the named building at the historic site distinguish the main house from adjacent grounds and structures.
geometryLabel: Mapped main house body. The survey specifies the projecting portico and both raised approaches.

terrainContact.basis: Approximate landing grade outside the land-side divided steps.

notes: The published seven-bay body measures 70 feet 5 inches by 52 feet 2 inches, excluding its portico. The survey governs the two elevations, stairs, roof and trim. The mapped outline is roughly 23.45 m by 18.17 m. Use its center and orientation with the more precise survey dimensions for the masonry walls.
